name: match-stmt-target-actions-test-90c95509c7/match-stmt-target-actions-v.bal
spec_references: Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.error: message
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: error:message
Expressions: Start action; Wait action; Type cast expression; Anonymous function expression
reason: The asserted wait-result fallback and guarded time conversions require var capture match patterns, outside the explicitly supported const and wildcard patterns. The error-result assertion also depends on error.detail(), absent from both supported langlib lists. Supported start/wait actions and casts do not bring those essential behaviors into scope.
unsupported_constructs: Capture match patterns var v, var undetermined, var seconds, var minutes, and var hours (including guarded clauses)
ballerina/lang.error detail() method used to obtain the asserted error message
test_design_notes: Assertions exercise the capture fallback with sum 23 and an error, and guarded captures for minute/hour/negative conversions.
